slides.title: Your *title* is why nobody clicked
replace: SUBJECT: a person squinting at something just off-frame, unimpressed.
COMPOSITION: the subject sits high and right, cropped by the top edge; the lower-left third stays quiet and empty.
COLOUR: electric blue-violet dominant.
SUBJECT: a hand scrolling past a face without stopping.
COMPOSITION: the subject is small and pushed into the upper right; most of the frame is empty ground.
COLOUR: hot pink dominant.

slides.title: Clever titles age into *nothing*
replace: SUBJECT: someone holding a blank card up in front of their own face.
COMPOSITION: the subject crosses the upper half diagonally; the bottom-left stays empty.
COLOUR: burnt orange dominant.
SUBJECT: a crowd of people all holding identical blank cards.
COMPOSITION: elements scatter, dense in the upper right, thinning to nothing towards the lower left.
COLOUR: near-black with a cold blue cast dominant.

slides.title: Name the *promise*, not the episode
replace: SUBJECT: a hand striking one line through with a marker.
COMPOSITION: the subject enters from the top-right corner; the lower-left is empty.
COLOUR: deep violet dominant.

slides.title: Curiosity beats *cleverness*
replace: SUBJECT: a face lit by curiosity, leaning towards the light.
COMPOSITION: the subject stands tall in the right third, cropped by the top edge; the left two thirds are empty.
COLOUR: electric green dominant.

slides.title: Six tools, *one* pass
replace: SUBJECT: a wall of people holding cards over their faces.
COMPOSITION: the motif fills the frame evenly and quietly; the lower left falls into shadow.
COLOUR: near-black with a green cast dominant.

slides.title: Titles people actually click
replace: SUBJECT: one person lowering a card to reveal their face.
COMPOSITION: centred and cropped, the lower half is empty ground.
COLOUR: deep orange-red dominant.
